content:
Implemented recursive delegation on branch `fix/recursive-agent-delegation` and committed it as `ea48cb6`.

The handler runs delegated agents, returns their output or errors to the delegator, and detects circular delegation. The Anthropic provider now exposes the delegation tool and supports the tool-result continuation.

**Verification:** Backend build and type-check passed, as did the delegation reproduction and a mocked Anthropic provider round trip. The handler suite passed 6 of 7 tests; the abort-controller timing test also failed on the unchanged baseline. The OpenAI provider test suite could not load because of an existing syntax error in the test file.
